title: A Visit to the Space Museum
description: A class visits a space museum and learns about rockets and stars.
instructions: Read about Nam's school trip. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🚀 Last Saturday, Nam's class visited the space museum in the city. They went there by bus. Nam was very excited because he wants to be an astronaut one day.
First, a guide called Mr Brown showed them a big rocket. It was taller than their school! He said, 'This rocket took people to the Moon fifty years ago.'
Next, the children went into a dark room with thousands of little lights. Mr Brown said, 'These lights are stars. Some of them are older than our planet.' Linh took a lot of photos.
After that, Nam tried on a real space suit. It was heavy and very hot. 'How do astronauts walk in this?' he asked. Mr Brown laughed and said, 'They train for many years.'
At twelve o'clock, everyone had lunch in the museum café. Nam ate a sandwich and Linh had a pizza. Lucy didn't feel hungry because she was too excited, so she only drank some water.
🎬 In the afternoon, the class watched a film about life on the Space Station. Astronauts there eat food from bags, and they sleep on the wall! The children couldn't stop laughing.
Before they left, everybody visited the shop. Nam bought a small model rocket for his brother. Linh chose a book about planets. If they have enough money next year, they will come back.
On the bus home, Nam said, 'This was the best trip of my life!' Tonight he is going to draw a picture of the rocket and put it on his bedroom wall.
